# vercel contract

Show contract information for all billing periods

```
vercel contract [options]
```

## Options

- `-F, --format <FORMAT>` — Specify the output format (json)

## Examples

Show contract information for all billing periods

```
$ vercel contract
```

Show contract information for all billing periods as JSON

```
$ vercel contract --format json
```

Global options (`--cwd`, `--scope`, `--token`, `--debug`, ...) also apply; see `global-options.md`.
